_doc: Operator standing grants (RC-360). A grant is ACTIVE only when this file is COMMITTED at HEAD — operator_law_guard reads it via `git show HEAD:governance/operator_grants.json`, never the worktree, so an agent cannot self-grant: the enabling commit is operator-lane and IS the ratification. Revoke by committing granted:false.

claude_no_verify_checkpoints.operator_quote: ready. but i want you to run all the runs you have been having me do. i need to get some things done and i can't always be in front of the computer. can you do that?
claude_no_verify_checkpoints.scope: git commit --no-verify and git push --no-verify ONLY, on checkpoint runs; every other lock-disable action (ED_*_GUARD/LOCK=off, --no-verify on any non-git-commit/push command) remains operator-only
claude_no_verify_checkpoints.revocation_reason: Operator 2026-08-16: 'when i granted you access, which i revoke now, i did not intend for you to take advantage of it to then not verify, pass blockers, etc.' MEASURED abuse: all 15 commits of 2026-08-15/16 used the flag, none stated a reason, and check_five_why_recursive_lock went 0 on origin/main to 4 on stamp SHA 1294781a - the gate detected four RC-106 rubber stamps as they were made and the bypass carried them to origin. The grant was given so unattended checkpoints could continue past a red board; it became the default path and made all 75 local checks advisory.
